description: The user has difficulty distinguishing between information that contradicts the passage and information that is not mentioned.
recommendation: Practice identifying whether the passage directly contradicts a statement or simply does not mention it.

description: The user struggles to recognize the writer's opinions and viewpoints.
recommendation: Focus on identifying opinion words and distinguishing facts from opinions.

description: The user finds it difficult to identify the main idea of paragraphs.
recommendation: Practice summarizing each paragraph before selecting a heading.

description: The user has difficulty finding detailed information within the passage.
recommendation: Improve scanning skills to quickly locate keywords and supporting details.

description: The user is often misled by incorrect answer options.
recommendation: Read all options carefully and eliminate incorrect choices before selecting the best answer.

description: The user selects words without considering grammatical or contextual accuracy.
recommendation: Pay attention to grammar and surrounding context before completing sentences.

description: The user struggles to recognize paraphrased information.
recommendation: Practice identifying synonyms and paraphrased expressions in academic texts.

description: The user frequently provides incomplete or incorrect short answers.
recommendation: Follow word limits carefully and answer using words from the passage.

description: The user has difficulty matching details to the correct table entries.
recommendation: Practice organizing information while reading tables and diagrams.

description: The user struggles to understand the sequence of events or processes.
recommendation: Focus on transition words such as first, next, after, and finally.

description: The user has difficulty identifying the correct labels from the passage.
recommendation: Carefully match labels with descriptions in the corresponding section of the text.

description: Limited vocabulary reduces overall reading comprehension.
recommendation: Read academic articles regularly and maintain a vocabulary notebook.

description: The user spends too much time on difficult questions.
recommendation: Practice completing full reading tests under timed conditions.

description: The user struggles to understand implied meanings.
recommendation: Practice answering inference questions using evidence from the passage.

description: The user reads every word instead of using skimming and scanning techniques.
recommendation: Develop skimming for main ideas and scanning for specific information.
